_comment: Optional. Settings → About you sets your name, practice and email without editing this file. To edit it by hand, copy it to config/owner.json (gitignored), fill in only what you want, and leave the rest blank: blank fields use generic wording. The _hint lines are examples, never used.
_ownerFirstName_hint: e.g. Jane (defaults to the first word of your name)
_practiceDescription_hint: e.g. independent consulting practice focused on operations and go-to-market for mid-market SaaS companies
_researchTriggers_hint: e.g. funding rounds, leadership changes, M&A, product launches, hiring in ops/GTM
_coachPersona_hint: e.g. You are my executive coach. I run a solo practice, sell a few high-trust engagements, and am building a brand through a newsletter. Ground every observation in the data; name specific people, deals and numbers; never invent activity. (How hard it pushes is chosen under Settings → Coach.)
_coachContextDir_hint: e.g. ~/Documents/coach-context — a folder of your own notes for the coach. Settings → Coach can set or switch this too.
_coachContextGuidance_hint: e.g. These are my own notes on strengths, pitfalls and what this phase of my career is for. Treat them as ground truth.
_mcpServerName_hint: The name the MCP server reports to Claude Desktop. Keep the default unless you run two copies.
